title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection') vulnerability in…
description: A low-severity injection vulnerability (CWE-74) exists in the Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki Score Extension affecting versions 1.43, 1.45, 1.46, and 1.47. The issue involves improper neutralization of special elements in output used by a downstream component, specifically in the includes/Score.php file. No patch or remediation information is currently available, and there are no known exploits in the wild.
